# NASA Goddard Space Flight Center — Thermal Coatings

## Snapshot

| | |
|---|---|
| **Country** | United States |
| **City** | Greenbelt, MD |
| **Tier** | Extended |
| **Primary ecosystem** | Space Thermal |
| **Unit** | [Contamination and Coatings Engineering Branch (Code 546)](https://etd.gsfc.nasa.gov/capabilities/capabilities-listing/contamination-coatings-engineering/) |



## Why it matters internationally

GSFC's coatings work produced the α/ε handbooks that generations of
spacecraft thermal engineers treat as canonical reference data. It
represents the longest continuous institutional practice of emittance
measurement for flight hardware in the public record.

## Scope of activity

- **Quantities:** solar absorptance · thermal emittance (hemispherical and normal)
- **Spectral range:** solar and thermal infrared bands
- **Methodology:** Routine solar absorptance and calorimetric/normal thermal emittance measurement of spacecraft thermal-control coatings; publisher of canonical α/ε reference compilations used across the space industry. Today the work sits in the Contamination and Coatings Engineering Branch (Code 546).

**Application domains:** spacecraft thermal-control coatings · α/ε reference data.
